en.translation: The night passes uneventfully. Dawn breaks.
en.description: Moderator message when no kill action happened (no wolves, tie, etc.).

en.translation: A chilling silence fell over the village, but dawn arrives without incident. Someone was lucky tonight.
en.description: Moderator message when a werewolf kill was prevented by a doctor save.
